How to test & keyboard controls

Match the targets on the work order, then approve a test sheet. Each new batch cycles to a different order. Refill after each eight-sheet pile. Delivery holds six pieces; the seventh causes a jam. Boxing takes 1.2 seconds, so make space first or stop the feeder. Clear a jam and run a fresh proof to recover.

Catch when the timing marker is green (0.25–1.1 seconds after arrival) for points and a streak. Early or late catches still save the paper. Gold Rhythm needs 24 good pieces, no jams, and 12 perfect catches. Slow speed is a valid way to learn; there is no time limit.

Before you run

  1. Match all three setup settings above.
  2. Run a test sheet and get an approved proof.
  3. Start at speed 1 to learn, or 2 for a steady challenge.
  4. Keep delivery at six or fewer; catch, then pack each stack of six.
